entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: Elderly renegade lifecrafter from Avishkar who protected Chandra.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker who calls Oviya Grandmother and saved her life.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother, Renegade Prime, imprisoned in the Dhund.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker friend of Chandra who helped find the Dhund.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: Consulate officer who trapped the group in a Deadlock Trap.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker Ajani came to Kaladesh to track down.

entities.name: Yahenni
entities.description: Aetherborn who hosted a party the group visited.

entities.name: Annisa
entities.description: Oviya's wife, who fell ill and died.

entities.name: Nalaars
entities.description: Family of smugglers who supplied Oviya with aether.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: Ruling body of Ghirapur overthrown in the revolution.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: City on Kaladesh where Oviya taught artificers.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Plane where the events take place.

entities.name: Dhund
entities.description: Hidden prison where Pia was held.

entities.name: Deadlock Trap
entities.description: Airtight enchanted trap meant to use up the air and fill with poisonous gas.

entities.name: New Culture Collective
entities.description: Organizing body for the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

events.summary: Oviya agrees to hide Chandra's abilities from the Consulate, and later witnesses her ignition during her supposed execution.
events.quote: she witnessed Chandra's ignition during her supposed execution by Baral

events.summary: Oviya meets Ajani Goldmane, who came to Kaladesh to track Tezzeret.
events.quote: Oviya made the acquaintance of Ajani Goldmane

events.summary: After Chandra returns and Pia is arrested, Oviya takes Chandra and Nissa under her protection, promising to rescue Pia.
events.quote: Oviya took her and her friend Nissa Revane under her protection, promising them to rescue Pia.

events.summary: The trio locates the hidden Dhund but Baral, warned by Dovin Baan, lures them into a Deadlock Trap.
events.quote: Baral lured the group into an airtight, enchanted Deadlock Trap

events.summary: Ajani frees them and the planeswalkers bring Oviya to safety.
During the revolt Oviya protects Chandra from Baral and is critically wounded; Ajani saves her life with healing magic.
events.quote: Oviya herself was saved by Ajani, who used his healing magic to preserve her life.

events.summary: Oviya aids the Renegades in their attack on the Consulate's Spire.
events.quote: Oviya later aided the Renegades in their attack on the Consulate's Spire .

relations.note: Worked closely with Renegade Prime Pia.
relations.quote: Oviya worked closely with Renegade Prime, Chandra's surviving mother Pia
Oviya herself was saved by Ajani

relations.note: Baral trapped her and ordered her shot.
relations.quote: the Chief of Compliance ordered to fire on her
